summary: Cadeler A/S filed a 6-K reporting a major shareholding notice under Section 38 of the Danish Capital Markets Act tied to the completed share exchange offer by Cadeler plc, part of the parent's redomiciliation from Denmark to the UK. Cadeler plc acquired 355,404,839 Cadeler shares (including 11,156,931 represented by ADRs), about 92.06% of capital and votes, issuing 355,404,838 Cadeler plc shares at USD 1.00 nominal. A stock-for-stock exchange, no cash terms stated. Watch the residual free float, compulsory acquisition and remaining delisting mechanics.
